description: walker content-aware viewer tree + speed control + egui built-in theming + FFWB-style chrome (minus command line) + per-version export UI + the section 8 integration round-trip (design.md sections 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8; plan.md Parts B and C). DEPENDS ON FEAT-001: the export UI consumes walrus_fmt::offered_formats / ExportFormat / export::to_*, and the integration round-trip exercises the real backends. Build the src/view/ tree (selector.rs, richtext.rs, html.rs, markdown.rs, csv.rs, code.rs, text.rs, mod.rs), transport.rs (speed multiplier UI), theme.rs (egui built-in Visuals/ThemePreference; catppuccin stays dropped), chrome.rs, export_ui.rs. Remove the old View enum / fixed CSV tab from app.rs; derive the renderer per-document via select_renderer(mime, name). NO webview, NO ff-* dependency, NO command line. Untrusted-content rule: HTML/Markdown render a safe subset natively; never execute scripts or fetch remote resources.
steps: In crates/walker/Cargo.toml add egui_extras = { version = "0.36", default-features = false, features = ["syntax_highlighting"] } (NO table feature -- TableBuilder is unconditional), pulldown-cmark = "0.11", csv = "1.3" (same minors as walrus-fmt). CONFIRM the exact egui_extras 0.36 syntax_highlighting::highlight(..) / CodeTheme signature against the pinned crate (read the vendored registry source or cargo doc -p egui_extras) BEFORE relying on it; record the confirmed arity in a comment in view/code.rs. If it differs from design 2.1, call send_message with severity warning before diverging.

TDD + implement select_renderer (pure, no egui) in crates/walker/src/view/selector.rs with the Renderer and CodeLang data-carrying enums. Write failing tests FIRST covering every design 2.1 row: each MIME (including application/xml and text/xml -> Code(Xml)), each extension fallback, the text/plain + .md refinement to Markdown, and unknown -> Text; one sentence-named assertion per scenario. Then implement select_renderer(mime: &str, name: &str) -> Renderer. Add crates/walker/src/view/mod.rs as a re-export/dispatch module (no logic beyond selection re-export) and declare `pub mod view;` in crates/walker/src/lib.rs.
TDD + implement the shared Block/Inline model and HTML/Markdown lowering (design 2.3). Write failing PURE tests FIRST: an HTML fixture (headings, bold/italic, list, table, link,

Implement the CSV grid (crates/walker/src/view/csv.rs: csv-crate parse -> egui_extras::TableBuilder aligned scrollable grid), Code highlighting (crates/walker/src/view/code.rs: JSON pretty-print via serde_json, raw on parse failure, highlight via egui_extras using the confirmed signature, unknown language -> monospace), and the plain Text fallback (crates/walker/src/view/text.rs: read-only monospace). Unit-test the pure helpers (JSON pretty-print, CSV parse to rows); grid/highlight painting is covered by the harness test or stays MANUAL with a stated WHY comment.

TDD + implement the transport speed control (design 4) in crates/walker/src/transport.rs. Write failing tests FIRST: interval_for_multiplier returns 400ms at 1x, 100ms at 4x, 1600ms at 0.25x; Player::set_step_interval clamps sub-16ms to 16ms. Implement interval_for_multiplier(mult: f64) -> Duration and set_speed_multiplier(player, mult), plus the transport controls row (preset stepper 0.25x..4x + fine slider) moved out of app.rs. Remove the #[allow(dead_code)] on Player::set_step_interval once called. The player loop/stop/wrap/direction state machine and its three existing tests stay UNCHANGED. Declare pub mod transport in lib.rs.

TDD + implement theming (design 6) in crates/walker/src/theme.rs: ThemeMode { System, Light, Dark } (default Dark) with a pure to_preference() mapping to egui::ThemePreference; unit-test the pure mode->preference transition (colours stay manual). Implement crates/walker/src/chrome.rs (menu bar File/View/Theme + toolbar + bottom status bar, NO command line) and crates/walker/src/export_ui.rs (list walrus_fmt::offered_formats(mime), rfd save dialog with matching extension, Original uses document.name, call the matching walrus_fmt::export::to_*, surface ExportUnavailable and errors to the status bar). Declare the modules in lib.rs.

Remove the old View enum and fixed CSV tab from crates/walker/src/app.rs; derive the renderer per-document via select_renderer; wire chrome/transport/theme/export_ui; keep app.rs under ~250 lines. Build and ensure the app still compiles and runs (cargo run -p walker is MANUAL -- do not block an automated step on the long-running GUI).

Extend the egui_kittest harness (design 8) following crates/walker/tests/harness.rs: add a deterministic headless test for a viewer widget behaviour (e.g. the speed slider drives the model interval, or the CSV grid renders expected cell labels) -- fixed bounded frames, assert widget ids/labels/model state, never pixels/frame-counts, never loop-until-timeout. Reserve MANUAL only for pixel-exact appearance and the rfd native dialog, each with a stated WHY comment.

Add the section 8 integration round-trip test (crates/walker/tests/integration.rs, or crates/walrus/tests/export_round_trip.rs; add tempfile to the owning crate dev-deps). Open examples/walrus-story.wal (document.mime text/plain), confirm select_renderer picks Text/Code, reconstruct a chosen version, export it to EACH offered format (Original, PlainText, Html, Markdown, Pdf, Docx) asserting each backend's well-formed-output check (doctype+escape for HTML, valid JSON, %PDF- prefix, zip-with-word/document.xml for docx, byte-identical for Original) and that Original reproduces the stored bytes under document.name. Use tempfile::TempDir for on-disk assertions.
Update ROADMAP.md: move "CSV column viewer" and "Export backends (pdf/docx)" from Stubbed/TODO to Done; record any MSRV bump + forcing crate from FEAT-001 if not already recorded.
acceptance_criteria: `cargo test -p walker` passes the select_renderer mapping tests (every MIME + extension row incl. application/xml|text/xml -> Code(Xml), text/plain+.md refinement, unknown -> Text).
HTML/Markdown lowering tests pass asserting the
transport interval_for_multiplier tests pass (400ms@1x, 100ms@4x, 1600ms@0.25x) and set_step_interval sub-16ms clamp passes; the three existing player tests still pass unchanged.
theme mode->ThemePreference transition unit test passes.
The egui_kittest harness test for a viewer widget passes (deterministic, bounded frames, asserts model state / labels).

The section 8 integration round-trip passes: walrus-story.wal reconstructs, select_renderer picks Text/Code, and every offered format exports with its well-formed-output check, Original byte-identical under document.name.
The old View enum and fixed CSV tab are gone from app.rs; the renderer is derived per-document; no webview, no ff-* dep, no command line.

`cargo build` (whole workspace) compiles; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean; `cargo fmt -- --check` passes; no .rs file exceeds 400 non-test lines; strict ASCII; ASCII-only markdown.
